d: Northeastern part of the Indian Ocean
x: The Bay of Bengal forms the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean, located between the Indian subcontinent and the Indochinese peninsula, south of the Bengal region. Spread across an area of 2,600,000 km2, it is bordered by many of the countries in South Asia and Southeast Asia.

d: Protected area in El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras
x: The Trifinio Fraternidad Transboundary Biosphere Reserve is a transboundary protected area located where the borders of El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras meet. It protects the Montecristo massif and its cloud forests across the three countries' borders.
